allowlist.reason: Non-applicable: advisory is a ReDoS in twisted.mail.imap4.wildcardToRegexp(), reachable only by a Twisted IMAP4 server that passes an authenticated client's LIST/LSUB pattern to re.compile(). Baluffo runs no IMAP server and never imports twisted.mail; Twisted is a transitive Scrapy dependency selected only as twisted.internet.asyncioreactor.AsyncioSelectorReactor (src/scrapers/settings.py). No fixed release exists as of 2026-10-17: PyPI's latest is 26.4.0, the version pip-audit flags, so a bump cannot clear the finding. Revisit at review_by: drop this entry when a twisted release after 26.4.0 fixes the advisory.

Non-applicable: allocation-without-limits in twisted.conch.telnet.Telnet.dataReceived, reachable only on an endpoint that exposes the Twisted telnet transport (manhole or a conch-based server) to untrusted peers. Baluffo runs no Twisted server: its only Twisted touchpoint is the reactor named in SCRAPY_PLAYWRIGHT_SETTINGS (twisted.internet.asyncioreactor.AsyncioSelectorReactor in src/scrapers/settings.py), it imports no twisted.conch, and Scrapy's own telnet console is disabled there via TELNETCONSOLE_ENABLED: False. No fixed stable release exists as of 2026-10-28: PyPI's latest is 26.4.0, the version pip-audit flags, and the fix ships only in the pre-releases 26.10.0rc1/rc2, so an ordinary bump cannot clear the finding. Revisit at review_by: drop this entry when a 26.10.x stable release is published and the pin can move.

Non-applicable: infinite loop in twisted.mail.imap4.parseNestedParens, reachable only by a client of a running Twisted IMAP4Server that has selected a mailbox and sends a SEARCH literal with a negative size. Baluffo imports no twisted.mail and runs no IMAP server; its only Twisted touchpoint is the asyncio reactor named in SCRAPY_PLAYWRIGHT_SETTINGS (src/scrapers/settings.py), and Scrapy's telnet console is disabled there. No fixed stable release exists as of 2026-10-28: PyPI's latest is 26.4.0, the version pip-audit flags, and the fix ships only in 26.10.0rc1/rc2, so an ordinary bump cannot clear the finding. Revisit at review_by: drop this entry when a 26.10.x stable release is published and the pin can move.

Non-applicable: DNS response spoofing in twisted.names.dns.DNSDatagramProtocol, whose client resolver accepts a reply on the 16-bit transaction id alone without checking the source address, so it is reachable only through twisted.names client resolvers (Resolver, createResolver, or MX lookups built on them). Scrapy's default DNS_RESOLVER is scrapy.resolver.CachingThreadedResolver (getaddrinfo) and Baluffo sets no DNS_RESOLVER, so twisted.names is never instantiated; the only Twisted touchpoint is the asyncio reactor named in SCRAPY_PLAYWRIGHT_SETTINGS (src/scrapers/settings.py). No fixed stable release exists as of 2026-10-28: PyPI's latest is 26.4.0, the version pip-audit flags, and the fix ships only in 26.10.0rc1/rc2, so an ordinary bump cannot clear the finding. Revisit at review_by: drop this entry when a 26.10.x stable release is published and the pin can move.
